about_comments: Fast, lightweight hardware control for Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 audio interfaces on Linux.
connection_lost: Connection to device lost (%s). Waiting for reconnect...
no_changes: No changes requested. Use --help to see options.
watch_starting: Monitoring hardware events in real time (Press Ctrl+C to exit)...
err_check_device: Please check if interface is connected and user has permission to access /dev/snd/controlC*
err_unknown_item: Unknown item: %s. Use inst1, air1, inst2, air2, 48v or monitor.
err_invalid_monitor: Invalid mode for output/monitor: '%s' (use: off, mono or stereo)
err_specify_toggle: Error: specify item to toggle: inst1, air1, inst2, air2, 48v, monitor
usage_desc: Lightweight control utility for Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 on any Linux desktop.
cmd_tray_desc: Run system tray daemon (default if GUI session is active)
cmd_status_desc: Display current state of input and output settings
cmd_set_desc: Modify one or more hardware settings
cmd_toggle_desc: Toggle setting state (inst1, air1, inst2, air2, 48v, monitor)
cmd_watch_desc: Monitor hardware events in real time in terminal
opt_inst1_desc: Set Input 1 to Instrument (on) or Line (off)
opt_air1_desc: Enable or disable Air Mode on Input 1
opt_inst2_desc: Set Input 2 to Instrument (on) or Line (off)
opt_air2_desc: Enable or disable Air Mode on Input 2
opt_48v_desc: Enable or disable Phantom Power (+48V) for both inputs
opt_output_desc: Set Direct Monitor / Output: off, mono, or stereo
opt_card_desc: Specify ALSA card index, id, or device node (e.g. 2, USB)
opt_lang_desc: Set interface language (e.g. en, pt, es, fr, de, it, ja, zh)
opt_json_desc: Output status in JSON format (useful for scripts)
